notes:
In total, 16 people served on the Alpine Community Planning Group (ACPG) at some point between 1/1/2024 and 5/31/2025. The group has 15 seats. Eleven people served the whole window: Lyon, Saldano, Simmons, Davis, Brown, Cossio, Garay, May, Reimund, Ross and Thomas. Four left during it:
- Amy Blake, Seat 2, about June 2024
- Mary Kay Borchard, Seat 1, 12/5/2024
- Mike Milligan, Seat 11, term expired 1/6/2025
- John Paul Sullivan, Seat 8, 4/1/2025

One person joined: Nina Gould, Seat 1, sworn in 1/23/2025. The officers were the same both years (elected 1/25/2024 and re-elected 1/23/2025): Chair Travis Lyon, Vice Chair Richard Saldano, Secretary Erika Simmons, with Mary Davis appointed Parliamentarian. As of 5/31/2025, Seats 2, 8 and 11 were vacant.

Seat numbers and appointment dates come from the county ALROSTER.pdf (Wayback snapshots from 5/2024 to 7/2025), the 12/10/2024 Board of Supervisors (BOS) Minute Order and the PDS emails. The current roster (7/2026) shows Seats 4 (Brown) and 6 (Simmons) vacant, but both were still active on 5/29/2025, so they left after the window.

Uncertain or excluded:
- **Lauren Rowley** (lrnrwly@gmail.com) applied in 10/2024. On 10/24/2024 the ACPG voted 8-0 to recommend her for Seat 2, but she was never certified or appointed. By 4/2/2025 she had said she was moving away. Not a member.
- **Sharon Haven** (zinfann67@gmail.com) is not a member in the window. The chair included her on member-list emails from 3/24/2025 to 3/28/2025. On 3/25/2025 she asked 'I'm not on the Board yet, right?', and she is on no roster through 5/29/2025. The county roster shows her appointed to Seat 11 on 6/9/2026, after the window.
- **Maria Rodriguez** (applicant, 4/2025) and **Nick Colvill** (asked about vacancies, 3/2025 and 4/2025) are applicants or inquirers only.
- **Kevin May** (kjmaycpg@gmail.com, kjmaymsi@cox.net) is on the county-wide list of planning group chairs, not the ACPG.
- **Preston Brown** (brown.preston@gmail.com) is only a cc on Loveland Reservoir emails from a member of the public. Not a member.
- **Roger Garay discrepancy.** In 1/2025 the Clerk of the Board relayed a statement to the Fair Political Practices Commission (FPPC) from a 'Roger Garay' (Form 700 address rogertax@ix.netcom.com). That person said he had not been on the ACPG since about 2021 (docs 48517607, 48517997). His Form 700 was still overdue on 4/11/2025. But a Roger Garay is recorded present at 2024 ACPG meetings and replies from rogergaray1940@gmail.com through 5/22/2025. I list him as a member based on the roll calls, the rosters and the BOS reappointment. Whether rogertax@ix.netcom.com is the same person is unresolved.
- **Chair address variants I did not attribute.** travislyoncpg@gmail.com appears on some Association of Planning Groups (APG) distribution lists, probably a misspelling. Borchard also sent to 'Travis Lyon' at direcog2@gmail.com and eduoffce@virginmedia.com, probably mis-autocompleted addresses. I did not credit any of these to Lyon.
- **alpinecpg.org addresses** (travis.lyon@, michael.milligan@) appear only in emails written by a member of the public (Russell Walsh). No email in the production was sent from that domain.

Name variants: Kim Brown appears as 'kim dawson' and 'Kimberly Brown'. Erika Taylor Simmons appears as 'Erika Taylor' and 'Erika Simmons'. The county spells Borchard as 'Mary Brochard' in one PDS email. Saldano's name is misspelled 'Sandano' in the 1/23/2025 minutes.

On sources: the jsonl bodies hold no attachment text, so the rosters, minutes and Minute Order came from the raw .eml files in data/raw/sandiego/25-3152/. I extracted and converted them in the session scratchpad; no project files were changed. I did not collect the June, September and December 2024 minutes or the February to May 2025 minutes; those periods are covered by the agenda rosters and the email threads.
